parsed.rationale: Both `ReleaseRepository` and `ArtistRepository` in the `Metadata` package share three identical members — `cacheKey:(for id: Int) -> String`, `entityKind:String`, and `lastSync:Date?` — and differ only in the return type of `resolve:(id: Int) async throws -> <Entity>`, which is `Release` for `ReleaseRepository` and `Artist` for `ArtistRepository`. This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single varying slot (the resolved entity type) across otherwise identical protocol shapes. Introducing a `MetadataRepository` PAT with `associatedtype Entity` and a `resolve:(id: Int) async throws -> Entity` requirement unifies both protocols, eliminates the structural duplication, and allows call sites to be generic over any `MetadataRepository`. No restraint markers are present on either record.
